scope: Implementation planning and an offline review prototype; the production Dash app is unchanged by this review.

decisions.title: Dark theme palette
decisions.reason: Your sentence specifies Blueprint for the light theme but ends before naming the dark theme.
options: Midnight Blueprint: deep navy with pale blue

decisions.title: Logo direction
decisions.reason: The marks are provisional vector studies, supplied in light and dark variants.

decisions.title: Clicking the logo and name
decisions.reason: Recommend returning to Meanline without resetting inputs. Put GitHub in a separate Help/About link so the main brand does not unexpectedly leave the app.
decisions.recommended: Return to Meanline; preserve the design
options: Return to Meanline; preserve the design
Open GitHub in a new tab

decisions.title: Workspace navigation
decisions.reason: Three top tabs preserve the entire left column for parameters and avoid confusing workspace navigation with the numbered form sections.
options: Top: Meanline design / Geometry generation / Mesh generation

decisions.title: Sliders
decisions.reason: Recommend precise number boxes alone. An optional exploration slider could be added later without constraining typed values or rounding them to its steps.
decisions.recommended: Remove sliders from the default view
options: Remove sliders from the default view
Retain sliders beside selected number fields

decisions.title: Blade velocity ratio location
decisions.reason: This is a turbine-level input, so it must not become a separate value for each stage. It is shown under Shaft speed provisionally.

decisions.title: First-visit theme
decisions.reason: Always retain the user's later Light/Dark selection. This choice only affects a browser with no preference saved.

decisions.title: App edition to redesign
decisions.reason: The optimization app already includes all three workspaces and optimization. The stable app does not expose all those features.
decisions.recommended: Optimization edition first; shared resources reusable
options: Optimization edition first; shared resources reusable

decisions.title: Changing the inlet property pair
decisions.reason: Preserve the current valid thermodynamic state when conversion is defined; otherwise request new values. Never reinterpret an old pressure as a new enthalpy. This offline review demonstrates the fallback by clearing both fields.
decisions.recommended: Convert from valid state, otherwise request both values
options: Convert from valid state, otherwise request both values
Always clear both fields and request new values

decisions.title: Meaning of the meridional axis always starting at zero
decisions.reason: Your word 'always' suggests enforcing zero even after zoom/pan. Keep horizontal zoom available; provide larger graph views instead of silently changing the radial baseline.
decisions.recommended: Keep radial lower bound at zero in every view
options: Keep radial lower bound at zero in every view
Zero on initial view and reset; allow manual radial zoom
